review_basis: read-only Blender 5.2.3 inspection of the saved asset

categories.name: Building identity and source match
categories.finding: Purdue FID 829, 234 Littleton Street, the chapter website, and exterior photographs agree.

categories.name: GIS footprint and campus coordinates
categories.finding: The transformed official footprint matches the pale multi-wing roof in the aerial overlay; source imagery is not survey-grade.

categories.name: Massing, story count, and roof
categories.finding: Three-storey height is photo-supported but estimated, wings are extruded to one height, and the roof object duplicates a full-height extrusion of the footprint instead of a cap.

categories.name: Facade and architectural details
categories.finding: Broad classical character is captured, but repeated openings and simplified entrance lack the photographed facade articulation and upper terrace/parapet detail.

categories.name: Materials and texturing
categories.finding: Portable procedural painted masonry and separate trim, roof, glazing, shutter, and door materials exist; the rendered wall texture is faint/noisy at this scale.

categories.name: Interior / interior decision
categories.finding: No interior is modeled; the lack of source floor plans is documented, but a complete-building interior remains unmet if required.

categories.name: Evidence and file validation
categories.finding: The evidence and fresh-open validation are strong; master integration and placement verification are not included in this standalone grade.

blocking_corrections: Replace the duplicate full-height roof extrusion with a roof cap/parapet and eliminate coincident shell surfaces.
Reflect supported roof-height steps between attached wings and add the photographed terrace/parapet treatment.
Refine the entry pavilion and facade opening rhythm using the chapter photos.
Improve procedural brick scale/mapping so it reads as painted masonry at the asset scale.
Reopen and rerender after corrections; request a new independent grade against the updated asset SHA.
uncertainties: No survey-grade height or measured elevations were found.
Available exterior photographs lack a confirmed capture date.
No reliable floor plan was found, so interior layout cannot be verified.
Aerial imagery supports plan identity but not facade geometry or roof heights.
